No. D 696
S.I., Special Branch Section
Date April 11, 1935.

REPORT

Subject (in full) Chinese Aviator Sung Dong-kong (孫桐崗)
- leaves for Italy.

Made by D.I. Sih Tse-liang Forwarded by A. Grubb C.S.I.

Sung Dong-kong, a Chinese aviator, who arrived in
Shanghai from Shantung on April 7, left for Italy by the
S.S. "Conte Verde" at 12.30 p.m. April 10, for the purpose
of taking undergoing an advanced course in training of aviation.

Sung Dong-kong is a native of Tsinan, Shantung,
age 27. He was educated at home and at the age of 17
joined the army under the command of General Feng Yu-hsiang.
He later entered the Paoting Military Academy on the
recommendation of General Feng. On leaving the academy in
1930 he proceeded to France to study aviation, and returned
to China in September, 1933. In March, 1934, he was presented
with a private training aeroplane by Tu Yueh-sung.

Sih Tse Liang
D. I.

D. C. (Special Branch).

copy sent to Group Capt.
R.P. Willock, Cathay Hotel.
File
J.B. Ross
11/4/35.

日期 1935年4月11日。

报告

主题（全称）中国飞行员孙桐岗（Sung Dong-kong）
- 前往意大利。

由督察司特良（Sih Tse-liang）撰写 经 A. Grubb C.S.I. 转呈

孙桐岗（Sung Dong-kong），一名中国飞行员，于4月7日从山东抵达上海，并于4月10日下午12时30分乘坐“康特·维尔德”号（S.S. "Conte Verde"）轮船前往意大利，目的是接受高级航空训练课程。

孙桐岗是山东济南人，现年27岁。他在家接受教育，17岁时加入冯玉祥将军指挥的军队。后经冯将军推荐，进入保定军校。1930年离校后，他前往法国学习航空，并于1933年9月返回中国。1934年3月，杜月笙赠送给他一架私人训练用飞机。

司特良（Sih Tse Liang）
督察（D. I.）

副总监（特别股）。

副本已送交
R.P. 威洛克（Willock）上校，华懋饭店。
存档
J.B. 罗斯（Ross）
1935年4月11日。

S. 1. Special Branch
REPORT
Date April 2, 1935.

Subject (in full) Chinese Aviation Students - Departure for Italy

Made by D. S. I. Duncan Forwarded by H. Goullet A.

In connection with the reported departure of 15 aviation
students from the Hangchow Aviation Academy for Italy on the
S.S. "Conte Rosso" on March 15, 1935, enquiries show that these
persons are apprentice aviation engineers of a superior class
who have been sent to Italy at the expense of the National
Government to complete their training.

Enquiries were also made with a view to eliciting the
names of the engineers but without result. As a rule, students
sent abroad by the National Government have their passports and
other necessary arrangements made by the Ministry of Foreign
Affairs at Nanking.

According to the World's Chinese Students Federation, 191
Carter Road, seven members of the aviation corps at Nanchang
left Shanghai for the U. S. A. on the night of March 15/16 by
the S.S. "President Wilson" but confirmation of this report is
lacking.

W. Duncan
D. S. I.

D. C. (Special Branch)

报告
日期 1935年4月2日。

主题（全称）中国航空学生 - 启程前往意大利

由副督察邓肯（D. S. I. Duncan）撰写 经 H. Goullet A. 转呈

关于据报道杭州航空学校15名航空学生于1935年3月15日乘坐“康特·罗索”号（S.S. "Conte Rosso"）轮船前往意大利一事，经查询，这些人属于高等级的航空工程学徒，由国民政府出资送往意大利以完成其训练。

也曾进行查询以试图获取这些工程师的姓名，但未有结果。通常，由国民政府派往国外的学生，其护照及其他必要安排均由南京外交部办理。

据卡特路191号世界中国学生联合会称，南昌航空队的七名成员于3月15/16日晚乘坐“威尔逊总统”号（S.S. "President Wilson"）轮船离开上海前往美国，但该报告缺乏证实。

W. 邓肯（Duncan）
副督察（D. S. I.）

副总监（特别股）

THE CHINA PRESS, THURSDAY, MARCH 14, 1935

Aviation Students Off
For Study In Italy

A group of 15 students of the
Central Aviation Academy in Hang-
chow under the leadership of Mr.
Chiang Chien-jen, director of
political affairs of the academy, left
Shanghai yesterday on board the
Italian liner Conte Rosso for Italy
for advanced aviation training.
The group is the first of a series
of aviation cadets to be sent by the
national government for aviation
training in foreign countries. The
second group, which is to go to the
United States, is expected to arrive
in Shanghai shortly from Hang-
chow.

SI,
Please verify very
discreetly and report.
The Italian Authorities and
Steamship Co. may resent
inquiries, but the Customs
may be willing to help.
MG
page_data.zh:
《字林西报》，1935年3月14日，星期四

航空学生启程
赴意大利留学

杭州中央航空学校的一批15名学生，在该校政治部主任蒋坚忍（Chiang Chien-jen）先生的带领下，昨日在上海登上意大利邮轮“康特·罗索”号（Conte Rosso）前往意大利，进行高级航空训练。该批次是国民政府派往国外接受航空训练的一系列航空学员中的第一批。预计第二批将前往美国的学员不久将从杭州抵达上海。

特别股情报员（SI），
请非常谨慎地核实并报告。
意大利当局和轮船公司
可能会反感此类查询，但海关
或许愿意提供帮助。
MG

page_data.en:
Min Sin Jih Pao (民生日報), a mosquito paper, published the
following article on March 15,1935.

CHINESE AVIATION CADETS LEAVE FOR ITALY

On March 13, the Aviation Commission sent 13
cadets to study in Italy. They left at 2 p.m. on
board the s.s. Conte Verde. These cadets had been examined
by the Military Affairs Commission at Nanchang. Upon their
arrival in Italy, they will have the rank of Lieutenant and
will draw a monthly allowance of $140.00. The pay which
they have been drawing while in China will be issued to
their families.
It is reported that the Aviation Commission also
contemplates sending a batch of aviation cadets to America.
No reports about this dispatch of cadets to
Italy had been published by the leading Chinese newspapers
because the authorities did not desire to draw too much
attention to the matter.
page_data.zh:
《民生日報》（Min Sin Jih Pao），一家小型报刊，于1935年3月15日刊登了以下文章。

中国航空学员启程前往意大利

3月13日，航空委员会派遣13名学员前往意大利留学。他们于下午2时乘坐“康特·维尔德”号（s.s. Conte Verde）轮船离开。这些学员已在南昌军事委员会通过考核。抵达意大利后，他们将拥有中尉军衔，并每月领取140.00美元的津贴。他们在中国期间所领取的薪饷将发放给其家属。
据悉，航空委员会还计划派遣一批航空学员前往美国。
由于当局不希望引起过多关注，主要中文报纸未报道此次向意大利派遣学员的消息。
